title: Hoodlum
description:
S1 E1
1930's New York. The black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. If the seeds of Harlem's urban power would not grow in the White city, the Black underground would form to take control.

title: Outlaw Posse
description:
S1 E1
In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

title: The Magnificent Seven (2016)
description:
S1 E1
Director Antoine Fuqua brings his modern vision to the classic western, a story of seven outlaws who join together to save a town from an evil industrialist! Denzel Washington, Chris Pratt, Ethan Hawke and Vincent D'Onofrio and Peter Sarsgaard star!

title: Tyler Perry's Madea Goes to Jail
description:
S1 E1
At long last, Madea returns to the big screen! This time, America's favorite irreverent, pistol-packin' grandmomma is raising hell behind bars and lobbying for her freedom.

title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Family Reunion
description:
S1 E1
A pistol-packing grandma tries to hold a family reunion, a funeral, and a wedding all in the same weekend.

title: Top Five
description:
S1 E1
Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.
